$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFOH (AIP France, chart dated 2026-10-01): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Havre-Octeville

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

service.atsHours: AFIS : HIV : LUN-VEN : 0830-1200, 1300-1645. SAM-DIM et JF : 0930-1545. 25 DEC / 01 JAN : A/A. ETE : LUN-DIM et JF : 0730-1100, 1200-1645. Extension sur PPR (UTC HIV ; HOR ETE : - 1 HR)

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
RWY 04 and 22 prohibited if crosswind higher than: 20 kt on wet RWY,; 25 kt on dry RWY.
Parachuting (NR 238) and aerobatics (NR 6290) activities prohibited simultaneously.
Sea bird strike hazard all year long.
Site likely to be covered by sea haze in a few minutes.
If wind from W to NW: possibility of wind shear and turbulences between THR RWY 04 and mid-taxiway.
Startup request mandatory during ATS SKED.
TWY A restricted to ACFT whose wingspan is smaller than 36 m and whose main gear overall width is smaller than 9 m.
Stand B and B1 in front of the terminal with handling request only.
Wearing a high-visibility jacket is mandatory on the Use of PAPI RWY 04 mandatory for any LDG by night.
PAPI uncoupled with PCL: PAPI in A/A O/R to AFIS PPR 24 HR.
STAP, available data: wind, cloud base, RVR, T, DP, QNH, QFE and specific datas.
STAP paired with PCL: 3 clicks on mic: LIL; 5 clicks on mic: HIL; 7 clicks on mic: PCL shutdown.
PUL and downhill paragliding: at "Cap de la Hève": MAX 150 ft ASFC; at "St-Andrieux" (between abeam N and NW of threshold 22).
MAX 350 ft ASFC outside ATS SKED.
MAX 150 ft ASFC till Cauville then 350 ft ASFC till area limits during ATS SKED.
PJE on AD NR 238: See AIP ENR 5.5.

Aerobatics on AD NR 6290: See AIP ENR 5.5 Request by mail: bsep-le-havre@douane.finances.gouv.fr; codt-lille@douane.finances.gouv.fr; operations@lehavre.aeroport.fr email subject: 'ppf le havre octeville' Specify following items: shipper identity and details; flight date / eta / etd in local time / dep and/or arr ad (city) + country of origin; flight type / plane type / registration; number of passengers + crew; 'gendec' / passport number and or id / goods to be declared.
JET A1: HOR RFFS niveau 2 ou supérieur uniquement ou sur demande auprès de l'exploitant / Level 2 or higher RFFS SKED or upon request from AD operator.
AVGAS 100LL: Automate H24.
Paiement carte TOTAL ou carte de crédit / Payment TOTAL card or credit card.
